name: human-fleet-growth
notes: Human AI step 2 (user, 2026-10-19: fix the bottleneck they're stuck on, bigger hulls, queue unblocking). Vanilla 2039 (3 runs): AI human factions stall at 1-5k SCV each while the player has 11-13k; summed AI human SCV 17.8k -> 21.0k in a year (x1.18) at ~55 SCV per ship. Measured bottlenecks (2034 diagnostic): generic MC 0 (Academy, Exodus), metals 0 (Initiative), $15-54k idle money, small hulls.
